title: Maintain a personal data inventory
summary: When collecting personal data or changing systems, suppliers or processing purposes. An owned data-flow and processing inventory with sources, purposes, access, retention and unresolved questions.
outcomes: An owned data-flow and processing inventory with sources, purposes, access, retention and unresolved questions.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When collecting personal data or changing systems, suppliers or processing purposes.

parts.title: Inventory data collection and storage points
parts.guidance: List product, sales, HR, analytics and support systems, data categories and collection sources. Include exports, backups and suppliers and use sample metadata rather than copying sensitive records into the inventory.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

parts.title: Confirm purposes, roles and applicable requirements
parts.guidance: Privacy reviewers identify controller or processor roles, purposes, relevant jurisdictions and required records. Record uncertainties and distinguish a technical data flow from a lawful basis or permission.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Confirm purposes, roles and applicable requirements

parts.title: Map recipients, access and retention
parts.guidance: Trace transfers, internal access, subprocessors and deletion mechanisms. Identify places where actual behavior differs from contracts or notices and assign owners to verify those differences.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve remediation and the processing record
parts.guidance: The responsible owners review undocumented or excessive processing, access and retention. Route high-risk activity to a privacy-impact assessment and approve changes before production implementation.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile the inventory with ongoing changes
parts.guidance: Link the inventory to vendor and release reviews and test representative data flows. Update ownership and evidence when systems or purposes change and retain a history of material decisions.
